title: The First Spacewalk Almost Killed Him #Shorts

hook.narration: In nineteen sixty-five, the first man to walk in space almost couldn't get back inside.

visuals.prompt: A Soviet cosmonaut in a white spacesuit floating outside a small capsule with the Earth glowing below

scenes.narration: Alexei Leonov stepped out of Voskhod 2 and floated for about twelve minutes.

visuals.prompt: A Soviet capsule with an airlock tube extended, a cosmonaut emerging into space, blue Earth curving beneath

scenes.narration: But in the vacuum, his spacesuit inflated like a balloon, stiffening until he couldn't fit back through the airlock.

visuals.prompt: A cosmonaut's spacesuit swollen like a balloon, gloves stretched stiff, fingers pulled out of the gloves, tense close-up
The narrow airlock opening seen from outside, too small for the bulging suit

scenes.narration: With his heart racing, he did something forbidden: he opened a valve and let air out of his own suit.

visuals.prompt: A cosmonaut's gloved hand on a suit valve, tiny crystals of escaping air glittering in sunlight
Extreme close-up of a sweating cosmonaut's face behind the visor, eyes wide

scenes.narration: Then he squeezed back in, head first. It worked, barely.

visuals.prompt: A cosmonaut sliding headfirst into a spacecraft airlock, Earth glowing behind, relief and exhaustion

description: Alexei Leonov made history as the first person to walk in space, and nearly didn't survive it. #Shorts #History #SpaceRace

thumbnail.prompt: A cosmonaut in a ballooned white spacesuit outside a capsule, Earth below, dramatic rim light
